title: fix(plugin-kanban): match kanban lanes by id only, retire title bucketing (objectui#10069)
body:
Closes #10069
Clause-②: no (it narrows, per the ruling)

Executes ruling 5816956837 on objectui#10069 (batch #222 item 3, letter A; the maintainer said 「同意」): **a kanban lane matches a record by its `id`, the option value, only.** Implemented by the dispatched dev of session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx`, `bucketCardsIntoColumns`: the lookup no longer maps `col.title`. It is renamed from `labelToColumnId` to `laneIdByFoldedId`, because it no longer holds labels. The source comment that said data values ("labels like 'In Progress'") match column IDs is replaced by the id-only rule and a ⛔ against re-adding the title key.
  - **Case folding on the id: kept.** It was already there (`String(col.id).toLowerCase()`), and the ruling retires the title key, not the folding of the id key. `IN_PROGRESS` still lands in lane `in_progress`. A pinned control asserts this.
  - Both doors are closed by this one site. Authored `columns` and lanes derived from the groupBy picklist (`title: opt.label` in `ObjectKanban`'s `effectiveColumns`) both reach the board only through `KanbanRenderer` and then `bucketCardsIntoColumns`. Because translated titles no longer decide membership, the locale-dependent misbucketing is gone too.
- **Loud, not silent.** A record matching no lane still goes to the trailing "Uncategorized" lane (#2792). It is now also named by a `console.warn` that gives the `groupBy` field, the raw value, how many records carry it, and the available lane ids.
  - **Dedup choice: one warn per distinct raw value per bucketing pass.** It is never per record, and never deduplicated module-wide.
  - Per value, because the offending record count is unbounded (a whole imported table can store labels) while the distinct-value count is bounded by the vocabulary.
  - Per pass, because one pass is one render or data load of one board (`KanbanRenderer`'s memo bounds it). Module-level dedup would stay silent for the next board, or for this board after its picklist or data changed, which is when an author looks.
  - The empty value is not warned about: a record with no group value is the ordinary "not yet categorised" state, not a value/label mismatch.
- Docs: the `columns` row in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` and the `KanbanColumn` block in the plugin README now state the id-only rule.
- Changeset `.changeset/10069-kanban-lanes-match-by-id-only.md`: **minor** on `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`, with the migration note.

## Pins: flipped, not deleted

- `objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx`, the title row (formerly "AS A BUCKETING ALIAS"): **flipped**. It now asserts a title-valued record is an orphan in the trailing lane, the id-valued record in the same render still lands, and the warn names `"in progress"` plus `"open", "won"`. The "value matching neither the id nor the title IS an orphan" control is **kept unchanged**. The file header no longer says `title` is read twice.
- Three more pins asserted the title alias and are flipped the same way (none deleted):
  - `index.bucket.test.ts` "matches by column title/label as well as id" now reads "id only (case-insensitively), never by title".
  - `laneIdCoercion-8993.test.ts` row 4 now reaches the raw numeric id through the folded-id lookup, and asserts the title-valued record is an orphan.
  - `prototypeGroupKeys-9043.test.ts` row 4c reaches lane `toString` via `TOSTRING`, and asserts `Done` (its title) is an orphan. Row 1c's name now says it holds through case folding.
- New `laneIdOnly-10069.test.tsx` has four parts:
  - ⭐ **A translated title does not change membership.** The same ids with English versus German titles produce the identical board.
  - A case-folding control.
  - Three warn rows: content, once per distinct value per pass, and silence for matched or empty values.
  - The **picklist door** driven through the real `SchemaRenderer`: with no `columns`, lanes come from `field.options`, and a record storing the label `In Progress` is swept while the one storing `in_progress` lands.
- `apps/console/.../registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: only the `pins` prose for the swimlane element, which described the alias, is updated.

## Migration: finding records that store a label instead of the value

Records whose group field stores an option LABEL (`'In Progress'`) instead of its VALUE (`'in_progress'`) now show under "Uncategorized", and the console warning names each such value. A one-off query for a select field, shown for object `deal` grouped by `status`, uses the ObjectQL `FilterNode` array AST that `dataSource.find` takes as `$filter`:

```js
// 1. The option VALUES the lanes match on, read from the field definition.
const def = await dataSource.getObjectSchema('deal');
const options = def.fields.status.options;
const values = options.map((o) => o.value);

// 2. Records whose stored value is set but is none of them.
const { data } = await dataSource.find('deal', {
  $filter: ['and',
    ['status', 'nin', values],
    ['status', '!=', null],
    ['status', '!=', ''],
  ],
  $select: ['_id', 'status'],
});

// 3. Per row, the repair target. The board compares ids case-insensitively,
//    so a row matching a VALUE in another case still lands and is skipped here;
//    a row matching a LABEL is the migration case.
const byValue = new Map(options.map((o) => [String(o.value).toLowerCase(), o.value]));
const byLabel = new Map(options.map((o) => [String(o.label).toLowerCase(), o.value]));
const toRepair = data
  .filter((r) => !byValue.has(String(r.status).toLowerCase()))
  .map((r) => ({ id: r._id ?? r.id, stored: r.status, repairTo: byLabel.get(String(r.status).toLowerCase()) ?? null }));
```

A `repairTo` of `null` means the value is neither a value nor a label: a retired option or free text, for a person to decide. Repair by updating each record to `repairTo`. Dragging a card from "Uncategorized" into its lane writes the lane id and repairs one record. ⛔ Do not add the label as a lane `id` to make records reappear: that re-teaches the label as a second value for the same state.

## Census: other kanban paths that bucket by title or label

- **Same shape, covered here:** `bucketCardsIntoColumns` is the only place records are bucketed into kanban lanes. Every host reaches it through `ObjectKanban`, then `KanbanRenderer`: the `object-kanban` node, `plugin-list` `ListView`'s kanban view, app-shell `ObjectView`, and the metadata-admin preview.
  - Measured by `git grep` for `labelToColumnId` / `bucketCardsIntoColumns`, and by reading every `plugin-kanban` source that lowercases or reads `.label` / `.title`.
  - `plugin-view` has no kanban bucketing, only view-config utils.
- **Different shapes, reported and not changed:**
  1. `KanbanImpl` swimlane rows group by the raw `card[swimlaneField]` value. No title or label is involved.
  2. The `ObjectKanban` card badge finds a select option by case-insensitive VALUE, then shows its translated label. That is display only and never decides membership.
  3. `plugin-gantt` `groupByAccessor` matches a task's value to an option and then uses the option's display **label** as the group key. It is value-matched and label-keyed, so two options sharing a label would merge into one group. It is not the kanban shape (a label never admits a record), and I did not reproduce it.
  4. `ObjectKanban` lanes derived from data when there are no options use `id = title = String(value)`, so there is no alias.

## Acceptance notes

- `prototypeGroupKeys-9043.test.ts`'s header still names `labelToColumnId` where it describes the code measured before that repair. It is historical and was left as is.
- The gantt label-keyed grouping (census item 3) is an observation, not filed: it has no reproduction.
